better_answer_example: In my final year of software engineering, I developed a strong interest in data engineering, particularly in using Python, SQL, and Azure pipelines to manage and analyze data. One project that stands out is the learning management portal I worked on, where I focused on implementing role-based logging and course access features. Although it was a relatively small project, I learned a great deal about the importance of access control and data security in educational platforms. I believe this experience has given me a solid foundation to contribute to data engineering projects and I'm excited to apply my skills in a professional setting.
